verdict.rationale: Typesense documents an official MCP server for Typesense Cloud that lets an AI agent create/configure clusters, build collections, index data, and tune search directly from a conversation, which is a genuine first-party MCP server offering. However this is scoped to the Cloud product (not the open-source self-hosted server), and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of it working, nor detail on the full tool surface. missing for 10: independent corroboration/hands-on testing of the MCP server, confirmation it applies to self-hosted Typesense, full list of supported MCP tools/operations.
